summary: This directory manages the core entity definition and validation framework, providing tools to define data structures, generate CRUD schemas, handle complex date logic, and manage schema-based data conversion and error resolution for the application's domain entities.
responsibilities: Defining schema-based entity structures and their CRUD operations
Providing reusable field definitions and metadata for entities
Managing conversion logic between entities and JSON formats
Resolving and mapping schema validation errors from AST issues
Standardizing date and time handling for entity models
relationships: Entity definitions serve as the central configuration used to automatically generate CRUD schema suites.
Data conversion utilities leverage defined schema objects to safely transform input data into validated models.
AST matchers interact with schema structures to translate low-level validation issues into field-specific error messages.
Field definitions provide the building blocks that constitute both the domain entities and their corresponding UI annotation mappings.
designDecisions: Utilization of the Effect library for robust schema validation and error handling.
Declarative definition of entities to automate the generation of insertion, selection, and update operations.
Separation of domain-specific entities from general-purpose utility schema logic.
Recursive type transformations to manage mutable entity states and optional field requirements.
